statistic: S = the sum over the comparison's pairs whose runs exist of T(first) - T(second), where T = net profit minus the run's exposure-matched hold's net profit; pairs with an AI arm count only when the AI arms ran

selection.rule: a development candidate is the first arm of a comparison that is not descriptive only, whose statistic is positive and Holm-significant, and whose arm has T > 0 at the base case and under every sensitivity, at least 30 completed trades, a drawdown of at most 15% and no stock above 40% of the gross gain; never called proven profitable
